TOOLING BURST FL-2 — fire lane round 2: light · particles · shader (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt 2026-09-16 "pivot to full fire lane until completed with fire"; conductor spec `agentic_orchestration/gandalf/notes/2026-09-16-fire-lane-FL2-spec.md` (read it — it is the design); ruling R-C5-87). task_id "FL-2".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4h, T4p, FL-1a, FL-1b and the new row "FL-2 — fire lane round 2 (cast half · ember trail · floor-light curve · living embers · peak halo)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/agentic_orchestration/gandalf/notes/2026-09-16-fire-lane-FL2-spec.md (the five moves with field names and numbers).
4. export/godot_import.py (G1 component after FL-1b: halo, socket, sweep, fizzle; the burst_v2 pieces phase; FloorLight/Flash/Glow layers; the E2 decal anchor), export/effect_kit.py (layer validation, pieces validation, travel_primitives), export/vfx_material.gdshader, runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json (+ _A), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/ice_bolt_e2/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, runs/C-5/cliffside_v34/ (staged real scene: scenes/cliffside.tscn, scripts/vfx_g1*.gd — READ ONLY; do not edit the staged copy, fix the exporter), runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd, runs/C-5/t3/FL1-fire-8dir-v34/events_kit9.txt and events_kit10.txt, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART 0 — FIRST, IN THE REAL SCENE (conductor R-C5-88; PACK v34 = props v25 with the seven dummies as vfx_targets; the staged project runs/C-5/cliffside_v34/ IS in your read allowlist; the conductor instrument runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd casts kit 9/10 east from (3760,640) headless and prints the G1 event log — use it). Facts: targets VfxTarget_41..47 exist (layer 2, foot-footprint ellipses at the prop sort points); an east fire cast logs contact at age 11 with body 5 = VfxTarget_46 (the hound at 4222,610) and ice at age 15 likewise — but BOTH pass VfxTarget_44 (the shield dummy at 3911,596; footprint 70.4×30.8 ellipse spanning x 3876–3946, y 580–611) which lies first on the line and whose footprint the bolt visibly crosses at release (release socket ≈ 3810,600; nose ≈ +104 px). (0a) DIAGNOSE why the sweep misses the shield: initial overlap at fraction 0 excluded / release_sweep_start null on the first frame / the emergence segment starting beyond the footprint / y-offset between the drawn bolt and the physics position — with the event log and per-frame positions as evidence; FIX so the first target whose footprint the swept shape crosses is the one struck; clause: east fire cast → contact body_index 3 (VfxTarget_44) at age ≤ 6, then NOT the hound (pierce 0); east ice cast likewise with the crown decal centred within 0.2 BH of (3911,596) — which also settles (0b) F-C5-25: ground decals anchor at the struck target's ground point (its Area2D position), impact peaks at the tip; realign the E2 probe only if it encoded the target centre correctly. (0c) The other 16 kits stay byte-identical; export exit 0; headless import exit 0.

PART 1 — CAST HALF: `cast.muzzle_puff {scale .45, frames 4}` (P01 head at 0.45 scale at the socket, oriented along the aim, α 1→0 over 4 frames, additive) and `cast.floor_light {radius_bh .8, frames 6, alpha .5}` at the caster's feet on release. Kit fields under `layers.cast`; validate ranges (scale .3–.6, frames 2–8, radius .5–1.2 BH, alpha .2–.8).
PART 2 — FLIGHT: `travel.flicker_frames 2` (palette band 3↔2 swap on the head every 2 frames); `travel.trail {rate_per_s 5, size_px [3,4], life_s .35, rise_px_s 30, lateral_px 10}` — additive band-2 motes shed from the head's rear socket (pooled, ≤ 8 live); streak tail `erode_noise .3`. Validate ranges.
PART 3 — CONTACT: `floor_light {radius_px 160, duration_s .35, curve "ease_out", tint "palette_2", alpha .6}` — replace the linear fade with an ease-out curve sampled at 0/.1/.2/.35 s in the trace; flash unchanged (2 frames); hit_stop 3 frames (assert present); shake: report the amplitude/frames the world script applies (no change this round).
PART 4 — BURST RESIDUE, LIVING EMBERS: `pieces.residue_s .6 → .8`; `pieces.embers {count [8,12], size_px [3,5], life_s [.5,.9], rise_px_s 40, lateral_px 12, bands [2,3]}` — additive motes rising from the residue heart for the residue's life, fading; pooled. Validate ranges. Trace clause: ember count within [8,12] per burst; every mote dies within its life; none live past residue end + .9 s.
PART 5 — PEAK HEAT HALO: `glow.peak {alpha .35, scale 1.06}` applied only during the expanded key-state hold frames (4); otherwise the existing glow (α .2, ×1.02).

Apply the new fields to runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (presentation.layers, provenance "R-C5-87 FL-2") and to the kits fire_bolt_e1_A, fire_bolt_e1_B and fire_burst_e0p_v2 (kit.json only; primitives/pieces byte-identical); ice_bolt_e2 gains nothing this round (fields default off — validate that absent fields keep every other kit byte-identical).

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-2/acceptance.json): Part 0 diagnosis + the probe_events output of a re-export of the v34 inputs (same command as briefs/C-5/CS-pack-v34.task.json, into runs/C-5/t3/FL-2/reexport/) showing body 3 struck first; per-part trace clauses with numbers (mote counts/lifetimes, floor-light curve samples, flicker period, halo peak frames); the 14 other kits byte-identical (the three fire kits: kit.json only); full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0; in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the new field validations; the trace clauses; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, fixtures/ (except a byte-lock re-baseline with a diff summary if the emitted scene text changes — same rule as FL-1b), any test file except the three named (extend only), any kit except the three fire kits' kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-2/ and runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (named fields). Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-2"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
